static.en.preview.credentials: All 3 connections include complete encrypted credentials

static.zh.error.category: 文件类别为“计划配置”，与当前“模型配置”不一致。

static.en.error.missingKey: Models › OpenAI production › API key: no decryptable key is present. Export a new complete package with encrypted keys from the source environment.

static.en.error.required: Plans › Pro › Repair limit: field is missing. Provide 0 explicitly when disabled.
static.zh.error.wrongPassword: 无法解密文件。请检查文件口令，或确认文件未损坏。
static.en.error.wrongPassword: The file could not be decrypted. Check the file password or confirm the file is not damaged.
static.zh.error.dependency: 有跨类别引用，不能替换模型配置
static.zh.error.dependencyHelp: 当前配置保持不变。请先在对应类别处理依赖，再重新选择文件并预览。
static.en.error.dependencyHelp: Current configuration is unchanged. Resolve dependencies in the referenced categories, then choose the file and preview again.
static.zh.error.itemDependency: 有发放历史或奖励引用，不能替换道具定义
static.en.error.itemDependency: Issuance history or reward references block item replacement
static.zh.error.stale: 目标配置已改变，原预览已失效
static.en.error.stale: Target configuration changed; the preview is no longer valid
static.zh.error.staleHelp: 另一位管理员修改了配置或相关依赖。请重新读取并预览，不能沿用旧确认。
static.en.error.staleHelp: Another administrator changed the configuration or a related dependency. Read and preview again; the previous confirmation cannot be used.
